transcript: My mission to see less theatre in 2026 is going remarkably well. It is currently the beginning of February and I have only seen eight shows. 8 and that includes The People's Filibuster, which I absolutely did count as a show because it's eight hours long and it had an all star cast and there were performances and a. A reason to be there. But that being said, I feel like I'm being a lot more conscientious about what I choose to see. I'm not trying to just see everything. And while I haven't loved all eight shows that I've seen so far, I am really liking the schedule that I'm curating for. And I feel like I am giving myself more time to sit with each show. So so far, so far it still feels like I'm seeing more theatre than I used to before I started seeing so much theatre. But I'm. I'm seeing like an appropriate amounts. I do think doing 20+ shows a month is a little much. I'd be okay going up to like 10, 15 shows in a month, but, uh, honestly, eight wasn't bad. It wasn't bad at all.
